key_decisions.rationale:
CancelledFolderTests.cs:69-103 and TopLevelTests.cs:282-315 are line-for-line the same loop body, including the message 'the canceller never marked the call'. `git grep -n "SynchronousIoCancel.Created = " -- tests` finds CancellationTests.cs:79/202/250, CancelledFolderTests.cs:42/73/241/256, StalledShareTests.cs:54 and TopLevelTests.cs:267/286. TopLevelTests.cs:241 says 'as CancelledFolderTests does'.
Fix: Keep one helper in Scans.cs, for example `Scans.RunCancellingAt(string root, int call, bool during, Func<string, CancellationToken, T> scan)`, plus `Scans.WithGuard(Action<SynchronousIoCancel>, Func<T>)` for the set/reset pattern, and call them from both tests.

payload.coherence_check: Each finding is fixed on its own and none may undo another. A finding that no longer holds -- already fixed, or misread by the finder -- is left alone, and the build says so.
